flags.message: context.distribution_count is 2, but the docket shows no true relist: the first distribution (Apr 28 2026, for the 5/14 conference) was superseded the next day by 'Response Requested' after respondents had waived, and the second (Jul 15 2026, for the 9/28/2026 long conference) is the petition's first real conference. The statpack's relist-count cut documents that the stored count is an upper bound on true relists; on this docket the whole count is that artifact, so the relist-1 bucket and any band feature keyed on it overstate the trajectory signal, while the call for a response (a stronger signal than one relist) has no cut of its own. The relist-increment claim was stated from the harness count of 2 as the contract requires.
